info.title: Software Engineer
info.headline: I build reliable backends, data integrations and polished frontends for B2B SaaS with Ruby on Rails, React and TypeScript.
info.cvTagline: Backend & Full Stack · Ruby on Rails · React · TypeScript

about: I'm a Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience shipping production web applications. Today I work on the backend of Spiro, an AI-powered CRM used by 200+ manufacturers and distributors, where I build integrations that sync data from ERP and e-commerce platforms like Epicor P21, NetSuite and Shopify, using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Sidekiq and AWS.

Before that I integrated Meta, Google and Snapchat ad platforms into a multi-channel campaign product, and I started on the frontend with React and Next.js. That path makes me comfortable owning a feature end to end: data model, API, background jobs, UI and tests.
cvProfile: Software Engineer with 5+ years building B2B SaaS and third-party integrations. On the backend of Spiro, an AI-powered CRM used by 200+ manufacturers and distributors, I sync data from Epicor P21, NetSuite and Shopify with Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Sidekiq and AWS. Previously integrated Meta, Google and Snapchat ad platforms, and started on the frontend with React and Next.js.

principles.title: End-to-end ownership
principles.text: From database schema to the last pixel, I take features all the way to production and keep an eye on them after release.

principles.title: Quality by default
principles.text: RSpec, Minitest, Jest and code review are part of the work, not an afterthought.

principles.title: Clear communication
principles.text: I work directly with Customer Success and customers, and I'm used to remote, async teams across time zones.

roles.title: Software Engineer (Backend)
details: Build backend services, REST API endpoints and product features for Spiro, an AI-powered CRM used by 200+ manufacturers and distributors, on Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL
Build and maintain ERP and e-commerce integrations (Epicor P21, NetSuite, Shopify and more), pulling data from customers' SQL databases and syncing customers, orders and products into Spiro
Work directly with Customer Success and customers to troubleshoot integration and data issues, and turn their feedback into fixes and product improvements
Built internal tools that show integration status and data per customer company, plus automations for recurring integration and operations work
Run asynchronous workflows and scheduled syncs on Sidekiq, using sidekiq-cron and unique job processing to keep high-volume work reliable and idempotent
Integrate AWS (S3, Lambda, ECS, KMS) for file storage, serverless processing and encryption of sensitive customer data, deployed on Heroku
Contributed to communication features: Twilio calling and texting for Spiro's mobile app, and email account connections
Keep production healthy with Sentry monitoring, RSpec and Minitest suites and RuboCop-enforced standards
Build and tune Elasticsearch full-text search, and implement authentication and authorization with Devise, Doorkeeper (OAuth 2) and Pundit

roles.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
details: Built an early-stage startup platform for media planning and launching ad campaigns across social networks from one place
Integrated advertising platform APIs (Meta for Facebook & Instagram, Google, Snapchat and more) for campaign creation and publishing
Developed it end to end: Ruby on Rails RESTful APIs, ActiveRecord domain models with complex business logic and a React/TypeScript frontend
Took the product from early development to a pilot with its first clients
Improved performance through SQL query tuning, database indexing, Redis caching and Sidekiq background jobs
Architected real-time updates and notifications with Action Cable
Built reusable React/TypeScript components with Chakra UI, following atomic design and custom hooks
Covered the backend with RSpec and the frontend with Jest and React Testing Library, shipping through CI/CD pipelines to Heroku

roles.title: Software Engineer (Frontend)
details: Built frontend features for Texttelligent's automotive product, mostly customer and service-department communication flows that let car dealerships text customers from one compliant inbox
Developed TypeScript + React/Next.js applications with a consistent Material UI component system, working closely with backend engineers on API contracts
Created UI prototypes and design handoffs in Figma

roles.title: Software Developer (Frontend)

roles.title: Frontend Engineer (Freelance)
details: Built the website for Scanspire, a penetration testing and security assessment company
